## Description

A STEP file containing texture data (`IMAGE_TEXTURE`, `TEXTURE_MAPPING`) is imported; texture appears correctly in the XCAF document. Saving the document to OCCT's binary XBF format and reloading loses the texture — the binary persistence layer skips texture attributes.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP file with a textured face; import, save XBF, reload XBF — texture binding is missing.

## Expected kernel behavior

persistence layer round-trips every document attribute including textures; if a kernel doesn't support textures, it must emit a clear "feature not supported" diagnostic at save time, not silently lose data.

## Notes

Provenance tier: requires-sibling-pair — texture lost across XBF roundtrip; needs both pre- and post-roundtrip files.
